name: atlas-query-insights
description: Atlas Query Insights deep agent for the Agentic Platform

scripts.build: if command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -d ../../packages/atlas-query-insights-agent; then pnpm --filter @repo/atlas-query-insights-agent build && esbuild src/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.js --sourcemap --external:@langchain/core --external:@langchain/langgraph --external:@mongodb-js/* --external:langchain --external:zod --external:dotenv && cp dist/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.js src/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.bundle.js && cp dist/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.js.map src/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.bundle.js.map; else mkdir -p dist/agent_atlas_query_insights && cp src/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.bundle.js dist/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.js && cp src/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.bundle.js.map dist/agent_atlas_query_insights/main.js.map; fi
